versions.content: EcucFunctionNameDef properties When a parameter rep- resents a function name in the configured software the EcucFunctionNameDef shall be used. With this feature functions (like callbacks) can be specified. The class Ecuc- FunctionNameDef does not introduce any additional attributes.
